result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Immediate and future locum and permanent job opportunities,

Locum rates circa $2000-$3000 per day with travel and accommodation provided.

Wide range of permanent jobs across Australia for $400,000+ packages.

The Positions

We are seeking experienced Specialists-Consultants in the following fields for permanent and locum roles across Australia:

Anaesthesia-Anaesthesiology

Emergency Medicine

General and Speciality Medicine

General Practice

Obstetrics and Gynaecology

Psychiatry

Skilled Medical will allocate a personal recruitment consultant to seek out and match your availability to job opportunities and take care of your placements every step of the way.

To view a selection of Specialist Consultant jobs on the Skilled Medical job board click here.

Consultant positions are typically available at larger hospitals across Australia where there are short or long-term vacancies for medical specialists.

As well as ongoing continuous roles, there are shorter term locum vacancies from 1-4 weeks and forward roster periods available of approximately 5 to 14 days per month on a fly-in, fly-out basis.

Specialist Consultants usually participate in an on-call roster. Rural placements provide return flights, use of a motor vehicle and accommodation.

Competitive remuneration packages are available for permanent placements often above AUD 400,000 with relocation, generous leave and CPD benefits.

UK and IE Qualified GPs interested in Permanent Roles in Australia

UK and Irish qualified GPs may be eligible for fast-track registration in Australia under the AHPRA registration authority's new Expedited Pathway.

For more details please view this link:

https:--www.medicalboard.gov.au-Registration-International-Medical-Graduates-Expedited-specialist-pathway.aspx

Essential Criteria

Applicants must be eligible for registration with the Medical Board of Australia-AHPRA, be eligible for credentialling in their GP disciplines, hold relevant CPD certificates of currency from RACGP or ACRRM and hold medical indemnity insurance.

Refer a Colleague to Skilled Medical

Referrals of candidates are also sought through a payment by Skilled Medical of a AUD $1500 gift card or 1500 reward credits per referral. Should you have a colleague interested in a role please find out more and refer them to us via this link:

Please Click Here to Refer a Colleague - Specialist Consultant and SMO AUD $1500 Gift Card or 1500 Reward Credits, Registrar AUD $1000 Gift Card or 1000 Reward Credits and Junior Doctor PGY1-3 AUD $500 Gift Card or 500 Reward Credits Per Referral

About Skilled Medical

Skilled Medical is quality accredited firm with 20 years of industry experience supporting communities and assisting medical professionals in their work and careers. To learn more about Skilled Medical please visit us at www.skilledmedical.com

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Experienced mental health nurse wanted to fulfil role of mental health clinical nurse consultant within a faced paced busy emergency department.

Employment Type: Permanent Full Time
Position Classification: Clinical Nurse Consultant Grade 1
Remuneration: $2,751.60- $2,807.90
Hours Per Week: 38
Requisition ID: REQ679399

Who we are: We are a health service that touches thousands of lives across the Northern Sydney Local Health District, together as a team of like-minded people. We are passionate, driven and have the skills and knowledge to care for our patients whilst creating the best services possible. Our teams have meaningful, interesting and rewarding work everyday. We challenge and nurture each other, sharing our knowledge and experience so that we can deliver better care for everyone There's a real sense of belonging here because we value and respect our patients, employees, and teams' voices. You'll feel a real privilege being a trusted caregiver in our patients, their families, their carers, and our communities' lives. 

NSLHD is proud of our diverse and inclusive workplaces, a place where health care professionals can thrive and feel they belong. We are committed to ensure that all our people feel respected and participate safely within a work environment without aggression, sexual harassment, discrimination and racism.

Where you'll be working

 
Royal North Shore Hospital

What you'll be doing
The Mental Health Clinical Nurse Consultant, Grade 1 (CNC1) provides an expert mental health assessment and initial intervention service to individuals of all ages presenting to the Emergency Department (ED) at Royal North Shore Hospital (RNSH). 

The CNC will be responsible for conducting a comprehensive mental health assessment for persons presenting to the RNSH ED who are experiencing mental health issues, The CNC, in partnership with the ED staff and relevant mental health staff will determine a plan of care which may be discharge back to the community with clearly documented and communicated follow up or facilitate an admission to the mental health inpatient unit. 
This position will be responsible for the management of patient flow for mental health in the ED and proactively assist with ensuring that Emergency Treatment Performance (ETP) Targets are met. 

The Clinical Nurse Consultant will promote a mental health nursing service that fosters excellence in clinical, educational and professional leadership, both within ED and the Mental Health Inpatient Units, The Clinical Nurse Consultant contributes to quality health care by collaborating with health care providers, consumer groups, and other community services by developing clinical practice and family orientated standards in emergency and acute mental health care. 

The Clinical Nurse Consultant will demonstrate a high knowledge of quality improvement principles, EEO and WH&S requirements. 

People of Aboriginal and-or Torres Strait Islander background are encouraged to apply.

Candidates will need to meet the following criteria:

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

Current unrestricted registration with AHPRA as a registered nurses and at least 5 years full time equivalent post graduate experience and approved post registration nursing qualifications relevant to the clinical area.

Demonstrated ability to initiate and lead evidence based nursing clinical practice in the assessment, care planning and care delivery of people with complex mental health issues in an acute setting.

Proven ability to provide clinical leadership to Emergency Department and Generalist clinicians in the management of mental health patients with demonstrated high level ability to network and communicate across a range of internal and external key partners.

About WCHN
Join the Women's and Children's Health Network (WCHN), South Australia's leading provider of care for women, babies, children and young people. We're shaping the future of healthcare through compassion, innovation and excellence - with our communities at the heart of everything we do.

What WCHN Can Offer You

Access to Fitness Passport (workplace health and fitness program that gives you and your family access to a wide choice of gyms and pools across South Australia.)

Relocation financial support may be negotiated, subject to eligibility. Click here for details and contact the enquires person for further information.

About the role

The Nurse-Midwife Consultant - WCH@Home provides expert clinical nursing-midwifery leadership and care to patients-consumers through virtual, face-to-face and Hospital in the Home services. The role supports clinical decision-making, complex case management, education, evidence-based practice and the implementation of models of care to enhance patient outcomes and access to care. The Nurse-Midwife Consultant is accountable for clinical practice, professional advice, care coordination and promoting safe, high-quality, patient-centred care.

Key duties of the role

Provide direct, expert clinical nursing-midwifery care, select and implement different therapeutic interventions, provide individual case management

Contribute to the development of, implementation of, and monitoring of corporate policies and processes and lead in their area of expertise

Hold a contemporary professional practice portfolio containing evidence of postgraduate qualifications, learning and practice experience that underpin a demonstrable application of knowledge and skills commensurate with the level and type of practice expected of the role

Contribute specific expertise to monitor and evaluate research activities in order to improve nursing or midwifery practice and service delivery

Provides clinical leadership and support to nursing teams, promoting best practice, collaboration, continuous improvement and a positive learning environment

Skills and Experience

Registered or eligible for registration as a Nurse with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia and who holds, or who is eligible to hold, a current practicing certificate

Demonstrated clinical competence and experience in relevant nursing-midwifery practice.

Demonstrated ability in clinical leadership, teamwork, communication and change management

Experience in education, supervision and support of nursing-midwifery staff and students

Knowledge of relevant legislation, professional standards and National Safety and Quality Health Service Standards

You will manage the sourcing and screening of candidates to conducting interviews and negotiating job offers. Your ability to understand clients' needs and candidates' aspirations will be key to your success in this role.     Key Responsibilities

 Source and screen new potential candidates through various channels, including job boards, social media, and networking events.    
 Conduct thorough interviews to assess candidates' skills, experience, and cultural fit.    
 Provide expert advice and guidance to both clients and candidates throughout the recruitment process.

 Meet and exceed individual and team targets and KPIs.     What We're Looking For     We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented individual with the following experience and attributes:    
 Proven experience as a Recruitment Consultant.
